notes.title: July update
notes.content:
- Implemented new kiteloop physics including heli loop with thermal winds
- Fixed bug in which during the landing the actual landing angle was off, sometimes by almost 30-40°, which often resulted in a player crash

- Fixed rotation counter that was not counting rotations when doing manual rotations

- Rotation on rails is now easier to control

notes.title: First July update
notes.content:
- Fixed bug where player wasn't pulling the bar to the hips
- Water splashes a little further than before
- Anisotropic default setting is now 4
- Included "jump distance" and "last jump" in HUD
- Improved iceberg visuals
- Tweaks to physics
- Tweaks to water shader

Known issues:
- Game might have to be restarted after the first execution otherwise the framerate is not very stable
- Water Shader is causing some performance issues: further optimization in an upcoming hotfix
- Water Shader sometimes is not updated at start, so the water might look greenish

tags.bug: - Fixed bug where player wasn't pulling the bar to the hips

notes.title: Graphics update
notes.content:
- Crash detection corrected: Player will crash if landing in the upwind direction
- Reworked some shaders to give it a little more of a stylized look and make the colors pop more

- Improvements to low quality water setting: now it doesnt look like total sh** anymore
